local rebirthCost = 50               -- cost of first rebirth
local taxRarity = 1/4                -- rarity of tax payment (less than one means greater rarity)

    if math.random() <= taxRarity then

        moneyLabel.Text = "Money: $"..tostring(math.floor(money))

        rebirthCost = rebirthCost + 50
        steps = 0

end)

end)
